android.desc:
Every barcode hides a beast.
Scan. Catch. Battle.

The cereal box on your counter. A tin of beans. The book on your shelf. That QR code on a poster you walk past.

Point your camera at it and something wakes up.
Nobody knows what is hiding in there until they scan it.

Every code has its own beast. Scan it tomorrow, or hand it to a friend halfway across the world, and the same creature turns up.

Most are common. Some are rare. A lucky few come out shiny.
Keep scanning and you might just find a legend!

Catch it. Name it. Make it yours.

🐾 SCAN THE REAL WORLD

Barcodes, QR codes, anything the game can read is fair game.

Your cupboard is a whole region you have never explored. So is your bookshelf. Your local shop. Every street you walk down.

You never know where the next great beast is hiding.

⚔️ WIN THE FIGHT

Your next favourite beast is out there. Ready to make it yours?

Some are weaker than your best. Others are much stronger. Some poison you and wait. Others just won't go down.

Spot the weakness. Pick the right beast. Beat your opponent, and it's yours to keep.

Already got one? Compare the two and keep the better one.

🧠 LEARN NEW MOVES

Every beast learns dozens of moves as it grows. You pick the four it takes into battle.

📈 RAISE A CHAMPION

Train your favourites and take them all the way to level 250.

Push one far enough and it changes shape entirely. Same beast, same barcode, bigger and meaner.

That ordinary little beast you found on a cereal box might turn into the strongest one you own.

💜 NO TWO ALIKE

Each beast has its own temperament and instinct. Proud or bashful. Fierce or watchful.

It remembers too. Where you found it, the battles it won, the close calls, the day it evolved. Trade it to a friend and its memories go with it.

🏅 TAKE ON THE CIRCUIT

Six guardians. Then the champion who trained them.

Four beasts. No changing your team halfway.

Bronze, Silver, Gold.

Win, and the title is yours.

🎖 EARN YOUR TITLE

Achievements for everything from your first catch to the things you will have to go looking for.

Titles come with them, and you wear the one you are proudest of. Your developer card keeps score, and it is yours to show off.

👋 TRADE FACE TO FACE

Sit next to a friend and swap beasts, or throw down in a battle.

No accounts. No waiting. Just you, your beasts, and the person beside you.

📱 PLAY ANYWHERE

Phone or tablet, the whole family can hunt

quotes.text:
My 7 year old wanted a pokemon game he could play while we did the food shop, so I built him one, turns out my friends enjoyed it too! Point the camera at any barcode and it turns into a creature. The same product always gives the same creature, so your kitchen cupboard is basically a region you haven't explored yet.

Android only, free, no ads. Would love to know what you think.
quotes.title: Show HN: CodeBeasts – Barcode Monsters
